column3: “kinsman” renders “relative”; “winnows barley at the threshing floor” renders “is winnowing the threshing floor of barley.”
“your best clothes” renders “your garments”; NASB supplies “best.” “put on” follows the read form; the written form has “I will go down.”
“to me” is in the read Hebrew text but not the written one; NASB omits it.
“his heart was merry” renders “his heart was good”; “the heap of grain” renders “the heap.”
“was startled and bent forward” renders “trembled and twisted.”
“last kindness” and “the first” render “latter loyalty (hesed)” and “the former.”
“all my people in the city” renders “all the gate of my people”; “a woman of excellence” renders “a woman of ability.”
“one could recognize another” renders “anyone could recognize his neighbor.”
NASB supplies “measures”; “she went into the city” follows some manuscripts, where the Hebrew reads “he went.”
“How did it go” renders “Who are you.”
NASB supplies “measures”; “to me” is in the read Hebrew text but not the written one.
